answer: The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The anchor assignment is published and ferrous records each panel. Shards are assigned from the spiral graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3112 identities would post 2386 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
